Government Notifications

1A - G 44915 - 33 (07/2025) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

THE order under section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.

The Order

By virtue of the powers vested in me under section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) No. 16 of 1907, as amended by Act No. 13 of 1966 (reprint), No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I, the Minister of Environment do by this Order declare the state land of the extent 46.44 hectares located in the area bounded by the limits set forth in the schedule given below, as Thulhirikanda Reserved Forest from 04th day of June 2025.

Dammika Patabendi, Minister of Environment.

Ministry of Environment,Sobadam Piyasa, 416/C/1, Robert Gunawardana Mawatha, Battaramulla,04th June, 2025.

Northern coordi-

The land area surrounded by the straight lines formed by joining the starting point (E. 139755, N.230957) to the final point (E. 139742, N. 230964) through given points and from there again up to the starting point from (E. 139755, N. 230957) respectively.

The Extent – 46.44ha.

Forest Conservation Ordinance

NOTIFICATION

By virtue of powers vested in me, under section 63 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) no.16 of 1907 as amended by Acts No.13 of 1966(reprint), No.56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I do by this notification notify that the Thulhirikanda Reserved Forest mentioned in the above order is subjected to the sole control of the Conservator General of Forests.

Dammika Patabendi, Minister of Environment.

Ministry of Environment,Sobadam Piyasa, 416/C/1, Robert Gunawardana Mawatha, Battaramulla,04th June, 2025.
